content: प्रहित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Placed, put forth. .²2 Extended, stretched out. .²3 Sent, despatched, directed; विचारमार्गप्रहितेन चेतसा <ls>Ku. 5. 42</ls>. .²4 Discharged, shot (as an arrow). .²5 Appointed. .²6 Appropriate, suitable. .²7 Imbedded (as nails). .²8 Turned towards, cast upon (as eyes, mind). .²9 Sent away, expelled; इयमद्य निशा पूर्वा सौमित्रे प्रहिता वनम् <ls>Rām. 2. 46. 2</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> gives प्रहिता = प्राप्ता). .{@-तम्@} A sauce, condiment.
